verdict.rationale: Apify documents official JavaScript and Python API clients in depth, covering running Actors, tasks, async log streaming, typed error subclasses, retries, pagination, Pandas integration and a changelog. Separate Actor SDKs add session and proxy management, base Docker images and a CLI-driven quick start, and an OpenAPI spec is published. The only community signal is enthusiasm about the SDK launch, not hands-on corroboration; missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality in real use.
